# Angel Cables — R K Enterprises

> Angel Cables is an ISI-certified manufacturer and supplier of electrical wires and cables based in Delhi, India (Lawrence Road Industrial Area). Established in 2005, it sells direct from its factory to electrical contractors, builders, dealers and industrial buyers all over India, with bulk and dealer pricing.

## Product categories

- [Armoured Cable](https://angelcables.com/products/armoured-cable): Steel wire armoured (SWA) power cable, 2, 3.5 and 4 core, aluminium or copper conductor, 1.5–300 sq mm, 1.1 kV, IS 1554.
- [House Wire (FR & FRLS)](https://angelcables.com/products/house-wire): ISI-marked PVC-insulated copper building wire, single core and multi-strand, 0.5–6 sq mm, IS 694.
- [Flexible Cable](https://angelcables.com/products/flexible-cable): Multi-core control cable (2–24 core), two-core appliance cable and copper-braid shielded control cable.
- [CCTV Cable](https://angelcables.com/products/cctv-cable): RG-6 coaxial (CCS and pure copper) and 1+3, 1+4, 1+6 video + power combo cables.
- [Submersible Cable](https://angelcables.com/products/submersible-cable): Flat borewell pump cable — single phase 1.5 and 2.5 sq mm, three phase 4 and 6 sq mm (pumps up to 15 HP).
- [Copper Wire](https://angelcables.com/products/copper-wire): Bare copper wire, tinned copper wire and EC-grade earthing wire, 0.5–50 sq mm.
- [CAT6 & LAN Cable](https://angelcables.com/products/cat6-lan-cable): CAT6 UTP (305 m and 90 m boxes), outdoor armoured CAT6, CAT5e.
- [Telephone Cable](https://angelcables.com/products/telephone-cable): TCBC wire, 2 pair, 4 pair and 10/20 pair EPABX and riser cable.

## Wiring guides

- [Which wire for an air conditioner?](https://angelcables.com/blog/which-wire-for-air-conditioner-india): Wire size for 1, 1.5 and 2 ton ACs in India.
- [FR vs FRLS house wire](https://angelcables.com/blog/fr-vs-frls-house-wire-india-guide): Which grade is required for which building.
- [Armoured cable guide](https://angelcables.com/blog/armoured-cable-guide-india): SWA vs STA, core configurations, sizing, underground laying.
- [Submersible cable for borewells](https://angelcables.com/blog/submersible-cable-borewell-india): Sizing by pump HP and borewell depth.
- [Copper vs aluminium wire](https://angelcables.com/blog/copper-vs-aluminium-wire-india): Why copper is used for Indian building wiring.
- [Common house wiring mistakes](https://angelcables.com/blog/common-house-wiring-mistakes-india): Eight mistakes and how to avoid them.
